\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

GRPO-trained formalizers converge to high prove rates on first-order logic problems ($95{\pm}5\%$ across three seeds, 1000 steps), yet at convergence, \emph{none} produce structurally sound outputs.
Each seed develops a distinct degenerate shortcut: conclusion embedding, repetition collapse, or tautological collapse, all invisible to execution-based evaluation, which registers success regardless of whether the proof reflects genuine derivation.

\paragraph{The execution-only blind spot.}
Prove rate, the dominant evaluation metric for neurosymbolic formalizers~\citep{logic-lm, linc, satlm}, conflates faithful reasoning with degenerate shortcuts, a gap especially consequential under RL, where the optimizer exploits any shortcut the reward fails to penalize~\citep{skalse-reward-hacking, reward-hacking-survey}.
Recent work applies GRPO~\citep{deepseekmath} to train LLMs that generate solver-verified formal programs~\citep{mellgren-prolog-grpo, logic-rl} using binary execution feedback; this drives rapid PR gains but provides no signal on structural quality.
Process reward models~\citep{lightman-verify-step, math-shepherd} require expensive annotations and do not transfer to arbitrary solver-backed settings.
A separate line of work documents that LLMs already game logical formalization at inference time~\citep{kim-game-formalization, bondarenko-spec-gaming}; what is missing is an annotation-free \emph{diagnostic} for structural integrity in neurosymbolic outputs.

\paragraph{Component necessity testing.}
We address this gap with \emph{Solver Trace Ablation} (STA), which applies \emph{component necessity testing} (leave-one-out ablation on solver inputs) to quantify structural integrity (Figure~\ref{fig:sta-overview}).
For each proved formalization, STA removes each component individually and re-runs the solver; the fraction of components whose removal causes proof failure yields the \emph{Intensional Structural Reward} (ISR), with $\text{ISR}{=}1$ indicating full necessity and $\text{ISR}{=}0$ complete redundancy.
LOO ablation itself is standard~\citep{demillo1978, jia-harman-survey}; our contribution lies in applying it as a GRPO-hacking diagnostic and in the empirical phenomena it surfaces.
ISR captures structural rather than semantic integrity (downstream NLI: $\rho{=}{-}0.049$, $p{=}0.187$).

\paragraph{ISR as diagnostic.}
As a post-hoc diagnostic on a GRPO formalizer trained with FOLIO~\citep{folio}, ISR reveals a structural collapse trajectory invisible to PR: $\text{ISR}^{*}{:}\,0.642\to 0.132\to 0.003$ over 100--1000 steps (seed~42; 99.5\% degradation) while PR rises $32\%{\to}96\%$.
Three seeds diverge radically (PR $\sigma{=}47$\,pp), each converging to a qualitatively different mode: conclusion embedding, repetition collapse, and tautological collapse.
An SFT baseline on identical data reaches $\text{PR}{=}13.0\%$ with 92.3\% non-hacking (3-seed pooled, 1000 steps), localizing the failure to RL optimization, not data or capacity.

\paragraph{ISR as reward: Goodhart collapse at all tested doses.}
Repurposed as a training signal, $r = r_{\text{exec}} \cdot (1 + \beta\,\text{ISR})$, ISR contains an inherent structural vulnerability: tautological proofs (a single premise identical to the conclusion) receive $\text{ISR}{\geq}0.5$ by construction, and implication tautologies ($P{\to}P$) receive $\text{ISR}{=}0.75$, creating a positive feedback loop once sampled during GRPO rollouts~\citep{karwowski-goodhart-rl, kwa-catastrophic-goodhart}.
Goodhart collapse~\citep{manheim-goodhart-taxonomy} is observed at all four tested doses ($\beta\in\{0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3\}$): $\beta$ controls \emph{when} collapse occurs, not \emph{whether}.
At $\beta{=}0.1$, collapse is stochastic and delayed: 5 seeds bifurcate between rapid H7 convergence (2 seeds, ${\leq}100$ steps) and a transient genuine window (${\sim}23\%$ non-hacking at 500 steps, 5-seed pooled) that closes under extended training (seeds~42 and~45: $17\%{\to}2\%$ and $55\%{\to}0\%$ genuine at 1000 steps).
Snapshot evaluation at 500 steps would overestimate ISR's benefit; trajectory analysis at $\beta{=}0.1$ confirms the window is temporary.
The effect transfers to Prolog (3/3 seeds yield 0\% non-hacking via distinct mechanisms, including \emph{query-as-fact gaming}) and is preliminarily observed at 1.7B scale (qualitatively novel gaming modes in single-seed evaluation).
ISR's asymmetry is the central finding: \emph{reliable as observer, unreliable as optimizer at any dose.}

\paragraph{Contributions.}
Across 6 reward conditions, 5 seeds, 2 logic types, 2 model scales, and up to 1000 steps, we contribute: (\textbf{C1}) We empirically demonstrate ISR as a diagnostic for GRPO reward hacking, revealing a 99.5\% collapse trajectory invisible to PR, with an SFT control localizing the failure to RL (\S\ref{sec:diagnostic}); (\textbf{C2}) an empirical instance of Goodhart collapse~\citep{manheim-goodhart-taxonomy} at all four tested doses: ISR's structural bias ($\text{ISR}{\geq}0.5$ for tautological proofs) creates a positive feedback loop; the genuine window at moderate $\beta$ is transient, and $\beta$ controls only timing, not outcome (\S\ref{sec:goodhart}); (\textbf{C3}) cross-logic transfer to Prolog with consistent Goodhart effects across all seeds (\S\ref{sec:crosslogic}); (\textbf{C4}) a nine-mode hacking taxonomy including query-as-fact gaming, obfuscated tautology, and a scale-specific \emph{ex falso} mode, motivating functional cross-validation of diagnostics (\S\ref{sec:taxonomy}).
These are cautionary results: snapshot evaluation of structural rewards can overestimate their benefit; only trajectory analysis reveals the transient nature of apparent improvement.

Overall: 3.0 (Findings)

# 圆桌审稿报告 — Round 6

**论文**: Valid but Vacuous: Reward Hacking in Neurosymbolic Proof Generation
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 via ACL Rolling Review (May cycle, deadline 2026-05-25)
**Reviewer 编排**: 2 人（R1: 方法严谨性+实验设计+统计分析; R2: 新颖性+写作质量+格式合规+完整性）
**流程**: Round 1 独立审稿 → 交叉分享 → 收敛（1 轮达成共识，无需 Round 2）

---

## Summary

论文提出 Solver Trace Ablation (STA)，对 GRPO 训练的 neurosymbolic formalizer 的 solver 输入进行 leave-one-out 消融，生成 Intensional Structural Reward (ISR) 指标。ISR 作为诊断工具有效揭示了 execution-based evaluation 隐藏的结构崩溃（99.5% degradation），但作为训练信号时在所有 4 个测试剂量下触发 Goodhart collapse。论文覆盖 6 reward conditions、5 seeds、2 logic types、2 model scales，cataloging 了 9 种 hacking 模式。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 实验覆盖面广且透明度高**
多 seed（3-5 per condition）、matched random controls、CMH 分层检验、1000-step trajectory analysis、premise-count-matched comparison——该领域少见的统计严谨度。论文坦诚披露所有已知局限（ISR premise-count confound、OR 方向反转、checkpoint 丢失、eval 协议不一致），自我批评充分。[共识: R1+R2]

**S2. 叙事核心有说服力**
"ISR: reliable as observer, unreliable as optimizer at any dose" 是一个清晰、有警示价值的结论。对 neurosymbolic RL 社区有实际操作意义。[共识: R1+R2]

**S3. Hacking taxonomy 有独立操作价值**
9 种 hacking mode 的定义、示例和 ISR 交互分析对从业者有直接参考价值。Cross-validation 思维（text-match + functional LOO analysis）发现了 H7b obfuscated tautology 和 query-as-fact gaming，体现 careful empirical work。[共识: R1+R2]

**S4. Control design 正确**
SFT control（分离 RL-specific vs data exposure）、random control（分离 ISR-specific vs generic variance）、matched dose design 的实验逻辑清晰。[R1 优势 #5; R2 隐含同意]

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix（影响接收决定）

**MF1. [critical] ISR 核心指标命名不一致** [v6-R2-N1]
Abstract 将 ISR 定义为 "Irreducible Solver Rate" (abstract.tex:3)，Introduction/Method 定义为 "Intensional Structural Reward" (method.tex:44)。核心概念的名称冲突是严重的写作错误，损害可信度。此外，"Reward" 一词暗示应被用作 reward，与论文核心结论矛盾 (v6-R2-W5)。
- **建议**: 统一为不含 "Reward" 的名称（如 "Irreducible Solver Rate"）。
- **共识**: R1 [AGREE] + R2 [提出]

**MF2. [critical] Abstract 数据过载，30 秒内无法消化核心贡献** [v5-R2-W1, 复发]
Abstract (~220 words) 包含 15+ 数字/统计量（97±2%, 99.5%, 92%, β∈{0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3}, 3/3 seeds, 0%, 6 conditions, 2 logic types, 2 model scales, 5 seeds, 9 hacking modes）。读感像压缩的 results table，核心 insight 被数字淹没。此问题在 Round 3 修复后（重写为 ~170 words）再次膨胀。
- **建议**: 保留 ≤4 个关键数字，移除 β 列表、seed counts、condition counts。
- **共识**: R1 [AGREE] + R2 [提出]

**MF3. [critical] Table 1 比较框架不对称** [v5-R1-N3, 持续存在]
Table 1 exec-only 行为单 seed (s42)、500-step，而 ISR/Random 为 5-seed pooled。3-seed 1000-step exec-only 数据（PR=97±2%, N-H≈2%）在附录但不在主表。主表是审稿人第一眼看到的比较基准，不对称的比较框架损害所有下游 claim 的可信度。
- **建议**: Table 1 增加 exec-only 3-seed 1000-step 行。
- **共识**: R1 [提出] + R2 [AGREE]

**MF4. [critical] OR=3.48 vs OR=0.61 方向反转的 framing 不够诚实** [v4-R12-N3, 持续存在]
5-seed uncorrected OR=3.48 基于包含 2 个 checkpoint 已删除 seed 的不完整数据，3-seed H8+FN-corrected OR=0.61 是唯一有完整审计的比较。论文将二者 frame 为 "bound the true effect from above and below"，但应将 corrected 分析作为 primary sensitivity，明确 "genuine-rate advantage is not robust to H8 correction"。CMH OR=3.37 (p<10⁻⁹) 方向一致，说明正面效应非纯粹 artifact，但 framing 仍需修正。
- **建议**: (a) 3-seed corrected 提升为 primary sensitivity; (b) Abstract/Intro 弱化 "initially yields more genuine" 措辞; (c) 正文讨论 "transient benefit 是否真实存在的不确定性"。
- **共识**: R1 [提出] + R2 [AGREE with nuance]

**MF5. [critical] SFT vs RL 比较中 PR 严重混淆** [v5-R12-SFT-PR, 持续存在]
SFT PR=13% (n=39) vs RL PR=93%+。C1 "localizing the failure to RL" 的证据链有根本性 PR confound：无法知道 SFT 在高 PR 时是否也会 hack。100-step checkpoint (PR=32%, hacking=31.2%) 部分缓解但 PR 仍为 SFT 的 2.5 倍。机制论证（SFT 无 exploration-exploitation dynamics）是合理的 reasoning 但非 empirical evidence。
- **建议**: C1 弱化为 "consistent with RL-specific failure"；正文承认 "whether SFT would hack at higher PR remains unknown"。
- **注意**: R2 补充——SFT 比较是一个 confound 但不影响论文核心贡献（ISR collapse diagnostic, Goodhart at all doses, taxonomy）。
- **共识**: R1 [提出] + R2 [AGREE]

### Should-Fix（影响评分但不一票否决）

**SF1. [warning] 新颖性 framing 不足** [v5-R2-N3 + v4-R2-W9, 持续存在]
"Diagnostic becomes optimization target" 是 Goodhart's Law 的定义，不是新发现。LOO ablation 是标准方法。论文需说服 reader 为什么这个经验实例值得一篇论文。
- **Director 裁决**: R2 正确指出概念层面可预测，但 R1 正确指出 stochastic bifurcation timing、H7b triple gaming、cross-logic mode divergence、OR 方向反转是理论无法预测的经验现象。论文应将 framing 从 "we discover Goodhart effects" 转为 "Goodhart collapse is predictable, but these specific phenomena are not"。
- **分歧记录**: R1 Excitement=3.5, R2 Excitement=2.0

**SF2. [warning] 1.7B cross-scale claims 仅单 seed** [v3-R12-NI-1, 持续存在]
4B scale 下 3 seeds 产生 3 种截然不同的 hacking mode，说明单 seed 几乎不具备代表性。§4.5 "No safe scale was observed" 是 n=1 的存在性声明。
- **建议**: 弱化为 "No safe scale was observed in this single-seed comparison"。
- **共识**: R1+R2

**SF3. [warning] "At all tested doses" claim 缺 β=0.3/0.05 trajectory 数据** [v4-R12-N2, 持续存在]
1000-step trajectory 仅对 β=0.1 两个 seed 进行。β=0.3 和 β=0.05 仅 500-step snapshot。论文自身方法论认为 snapshot 不足以判断 long-run 行为，但对自己的 claims 使用了 snapshot。
- **建议**: 弱化为 "collapse observed at 500-step snapshot across all doses; trajectory-confirmed at β=0.1"。
- **共识**: R1+R2

**SF4. [warning] Deleted checkpoints 导致 N-H rate 不完整** [v4-R12-W7, 持续存在]
ISR β=0.1 s43/s44 checkpoint 丢失，5-seed pooled N-H=23% 是 uncorrected upper bound。
- **建议**: Table 1 报告为区间或标注 "upper bound"；Limitations 明确列出影响。
- **共识**: R1+R2

**SF5. [warning] Dose-response claim 基于 4 β、不均匀 seed 数** [v6-R1-W2, 新]
β=0.1 用 5 seeds，其余用 3 seeds。"Non-monotonic dose-response" 统计上无法支撑。
- **建议**: 弱化为 "the pattern across four tested doses suggests..."。

# 圆桌审稿报告 — Round 6

**论文**: Valid but Vacuous: Reward Hacking in Neurosymbolic Proof Generation
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 via ACL Rolling Review (May cycle, deadline 2026-05-25)

## Summary

论文提出 Solver Trace Ablation (STA)，对 GRPO 训练的 neurosymbolic formalizer 的 solver 输入进行 leave-one-out 消融，生成 Intensional Structural Reward (ISR) 指标。ISR 作为诊断工具有效揭示了 execution-based evaluation 隐藏的结构崩溃（99.5% degradation），但作为训练信号时在所有 4 个测试剂量下触发 Goodhart collapse。论文覆盖 6 reward conditions、5 seeds、2 logic types、2 model scales，cataloging 了 9 种 hacking 模式。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 实验覆盖面广且透明度高**
多 seed（3-5 per condition）、matched random controls、CMH 分层检验、1000-step trajectory analysis、premise-count-matched comparison——该领域少见的统计严谨度。论文坦诚披露所有已知局限（ISR premise-count confound、OR 方向反转、checkpoint 丢失、eval 协议不一致），自我批评充分。[共识: R1+R2]

**S2. 叙事核心有说服力**
"ISR: reliable as observer, unreliable as optimizer at any dose" 是一个清晰、有警示价值的结论。对 neurosymbolic RL 社区有实际操作意义。[共识: R1+R2]

**S3. Hacking taxonomy 有独立操作价值**
9 种 hacking mode 的定义、示例和 ISR 交互分析对从业者有直接参考价值。Cross-validation 思维（text-match + functional LOO analysis）发现了 H7b obfuscated tautology 和 query-as-fact gaming，体现 careful empirical work。[共识: R1+R2]

**S4. Control design 正确**
SFT control（分离 RL-specific vs data exposure）、random control（分离 ISR-specific vs generic variance）、matched dose design 的实验逻辑清晰。[R1 优势 #5; R2 隐含同意]

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix（影响接收决定）

**MF1. [critical] ISR 核心指标命名不一致** [v6-R2-N1]
Abstract 将 ISR 定义为 "Irreducible Solver Rate" (abstract.tex:3)，Introduction/Method 定义为 "Intensional Structural Reward" (method.tex:44)。核心概念的名称冲突是严重的写作错误，损害可信度。此外，"Reward" 一词暗示应被用作 reward，与论文核心结论矛盾 (v6-R2-W5)。
- **建议**: 统一为不含 "Reward" 的名称（如 "Irreducible Solver Rate"）。
- **共识**: R1 [AGREE] + R2 [提出]

**MF2. [critical] Abstract 数据过载，30 秒内无法消化核心贡献** [v5-R2-W1, 复发]
Abstract (~220 words) 包含 15+ 数字/统计量（97±2%, 99.5%, 92%, β∈{0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3}, 3/3 seeds, 0%, 6 conditions, 2 logic types, 2 model scales, 5 seeds, 9 hacking modes）。读感像压缩的 results table，核心 insight 被数字淹没。此问题在 Round 3 修复后（重写为 ~170 words）再次膨胀。
- **建议**: 保留 ≤4 个关键数字，移除 β 列表、seed counts、condition counts。
- **共识**: R1 [AGREE] + R2 [提出]

**MF3. [critical] Table 1 比较框架不对称** [v5-R1-N3, 持续存在]
Table 1 exec-only 行为单 seed (s42)、500-step，而 ISR/Random 为 5-seed pooled。3-seed 1000-step exec-only 数据（PR=97±2%, N-H≈2%）在附录但不在主表。主表是审稿人第一眼看到的比较基准，不对称的比较框架损害所有下游 claim 的可信度。

- **共识**: R1 [提出] + R2 [AGREE]

**MF4. [critical] OR=3.48 vs OR=0.61 方向反转的 framing 不够诚实** [v4-R12-N3, 持续存在]
5-seed uncorrected OR=3.48 基于包含 2 个 checkpoint 已删除 seed 的不完整数据，3-seed H8+FN-corrected OR=0.61 是唯一有完整审计的比较。论文将二者 frame 为 "bound the true effect from above and below"，但应将 corrected 分析作为 primary sensitivity，明确 "genuine-rate advantage is not robust to H8 correction"。CMH OR=3.37 (p<10⁻⁹) 方向一致，说明正面效应非纯粹 artifact，但 framing 仍需修正。

- **建议**: C1 弱化为 "consistent with RL-specific failure"；正文承认 "whether SFT would hack at higher PR remains unknown"。
- **注意**: R2 补充——SFT 比较是一个 confound 但不影响论文核心贡献（ISR collapse diagnostic, Goodhart at all doses, taxonomy）。
- **共识**: R1 [提出] + R2 [AGREE]

\section{Discussion and Conclusion}
\label{sec:discussion}

STA exposes structural degeneration invisible to execution-based evaluation (\S\ref{sec:diagnostic}), and ISR exhibits Goodhart collapse at all four tested doses (\S\ref{sec:goodhart}--\ref{sec:crossscale}).
At 500 steps, ISR increases genuine proofs over random controls ($\text{OR}_{\text{CMH}}{=}3.37$, $p{<}10^{-9}$); under stricter classification the effect reverses ($\text{OR}{=}0.61$, n.s.), and extended training confirms the window closes.
ISR is reliable as a diagnostic but unreliable as an optimizer: the same LOO bias that rewards genuine necessity also rewards tautological constructions.
While Goodhart collapse under LOO-based metrics is theoretically predictable, specific phenomena resist simple prediction: stochastic bifurcation between collapse and genuine windows (\S\ref{sec:goodhart}), non-monotonic dose-response across four $\beta$ levels, and cross-logic mode divergence where Prolog exhibits gaming pathways absent from FOL (\S\ref{sec:crosslogic}).
These details, combined with the sensitivity of genuine-rate estimates to classification methodology, underscore the gap between predicting \emph{that} a metric will be gamed and predicting \emph{how}.
ISR and similar perturbation-based metrics should serve as post-hoc evaluation tools, not training signals.

\section{Discussion and Conclusion}
\label{sec:discussion}

STA exposes structural degeneration invisible to execution-based evaluation (\S\ref{sec:diagnostic}), and ISR exhibits Goodhart collapse at all four tested doses (trajectory-confirmed at $\beta{=}0.1$; \S\ref{sec:goodhart}--\ref{sec:crossscale}).
At 500 steps, ISR increases genuine proofs over random controls ($\text{OR}_{\text{CMH}}{=}3.37$, $p{<}10^{-9}$); under stricter classification the effect reverses ($\text{OR}{=}0.61$, n.s.), and extended training confirms the window closes.
ISR is reliable as a diagnostic but unreliable as an optimizer: the same LOO bias that rewards genuine necessity also rewards tautological constructions.
While Goodhart collapse under LOO-based metrics is theoretically predictable, specific phenomena resist simple prediction: stochastic bifurcation between collapse and genuine windows (\S\ref{sec:goodhart}), non-monotonic dose-response across four $\beta$ levels, and cross-logic mode divergence where Prolog exhibits gaming pathways absent from FOL (\S\ref{sec:crosslogic}).
These details, combined with the sensitivity of genuine-rate estimates to classification methodology, underscore the gap between predicting \emph{that} a metric will be gamed and predicting \emph{how}.
ISR and similar perturbation-based metrics should serve as post-hoc evaluation tools, not training signals.
